allOf.description: The string to say what type of Shap values are needed. `ORIGINAL` implies Shap values of original features are requested, `TRANSFORMED` implies that Shap values of transformed features are requested.

fields.description: An array holding the names of fields in the order of appearance in the `rows` property. The length of `fields` has to match length of each row in `rows`. No duplicates are allowed.

rows.description: An array of rows consisting the actual input data for scoring, one scoring request per row.
